about: Wayback captures wanted for the Nexstar, TEGNA and Scripps adapters (piece s4b). 'cdx' and 'snapshots' are every listing and capture this part has asked the archive-captures workflow for (they can be merged into pipeline/config/archive-requests.json as they are); 'requests' records each request commit, the workflow run it started and what the run downloaded. Snapshots were picked for storm days: the school days on which NWS winter warnings (the weights piece's Iowa Environmental Mesonet archive, snowlight.sources.stations.storms) covered the station's market most, as exact captures from the CDX listings where the page was listed, else as the archive's nearest capture to that morning; for the legacy list files, the capture of the file nearest to a page capture that framed it. The captures prove the archived page variants the adapters read (pipeline/tests/stations/fixtures/groups/) and which stations' lists have been seen populated (the proven share in coverage.json). 'no_endpoint_nexstar' lists, for each Nexstar site that was registered with no endpoint on 2026-09-27 (WDAF included), every listing and capture asked for it from that day on, with the commit that asked and why each capture was picked (a storm day and its market score, a retry, or a capture picked from a listing). 'no_endpoint_scripps_tegna' lists the same for each Scripps and TEGNA site registered with no endpoint on 2026-09-27 (KMSB, KJCT, KKCO, KKTV and KMVT, whose sites are Gray's, by the older hosts they had), every listing and capture asked for it from 2026-09-28 on.
notes: The Wayback Machine holds nothing for seven TEGNA hosts: kare11.com (KARE), 9news.com (KUSA), wkyc.com (WKYC), 11alive.com (WXIA), wbir.com (WBIR), wgrz.com (WGRZ) and wzzm13.com (WZZM). Their /closings CDX listings (run 36281601087) are empty, and id_ requests for them (run 36285593343) answered HTTP 403 without redirecting to any capture; run 36300019096 lists each host's front page to confirm the host is excluded. These stations can be proven only by a live read with rows.

Many 2023-2026 captures of TEGNA /closings pages are 403 answers the archive's crawler received (the CDX listings mark them 403), and the nearest-capture requests of run 36285593343 landed on 44 such captures; later requests pick exact 200 captures from the listings.

Two 2025-2026 captures of TEGNA /closings pages (WTHR 20260128173044, KREM 20250416212539) are redirects the archive's crawler was given to the stations' YouTube channels; the adapter refuses those bodies.

Run 36300019096 confirmed the exclusion: the CDX server answered HTTP 403 for kare11.com, 9news.com, wkyc.com, 11alive.com, wbir.com, wgrz.com and wzzm13.com themselves, while the same query for wusa9.com listed 153 captures (job log of run 36300019096). Four more TEGNA pages behave the same way (an empty /closings listing and id_ requests answered 403 without a capture): wltx.com, wtsp.com, firstcoastnews.com (WTLV) and 13wmaz.com. KCAU's page (kcau9.com/weather/closings/) was never captured (empty listing, id_ requests answered 404).

Run 36300019096 was cancelled at the job's 350-minute limit while listing: its snapshots (137 of 193 downloaded, 41 not attempted) and 39 of its 90 listings were uploaded; run 36318474516 (commit 03e6d22) asks again for what it had no time for and for exact storm-day captures picked from the new listings.
cdn.trb.tv, the Tribune stations' list host, served a domain-sale page by November 2020 (WDAF's allactive.html captured 20201107163159); kept as a refused body in the fixtures.

Until commit 0491318 (2026-09-27) no listing or capture had been asked for any of the 44 Nexstar sites registered with no endpoint except WDAF, although their registry evidence said captures were requested. Since then: 0491318 (149 listings of their closings paths and app feeds; run 36320180498 returned 76 before the job limit), 7743961 (103 storm-day captures), 509a934 (four listings of pages their REST APIs named), 2d37c18 (67 captures; 52 downloaded), ed1cccf (48 exact captures picked from the listings, among them app-feed captures larger than an empty feed's; all downloaded), 329a3c8 (the 73 listings not returned; run 36341557928 returned 51), e85e61f (45 captures and two listings; 39 downloaded), bd9e904 (24 exact captures from the new listings; 23 downloaded), 00d80e0 (the exact addresses of the 22 listings neither run returned; 20 returned) and 6102d4a (the ten app-feed and page captures those exact listings showed worth reading; all downloaded). Each site's evidence names what was asked and what came back. Seventeen of the 44 (WDAF, WXIN, WANE, WHBF, WRIC, KWKT, WJBF, WUTR, WSAV, WLAX, WNCN, WVNS, WNCT, KLBK, KMID, KGET, WBRE) had their closings page archived with rows, and the app feed itself was archived with rows at WHBF (five captures, 2024-12-14 to 2025-12-15), WANE (2025-01-15, 6 rows), WRIC (five captures, 2025-01-17 to 2026-02-08), WDAF (2025-02-14, 1 row) and WBRE (2025-01-19, 1 row, at its former domain's feed address); those are registered with the app feed as data_url and the archived page as page_url (WBRE's on its former domain, pahomepage.com, now 2822news.com).

The captures of the 44 sites' older pages also showed three list variants the adapters had not read, now read and kept as fixtures: the Liferay-era Nexstar 'Closing Alerts' module (WJMN 2016-03-17 with a row, WBRE 2017-02-07 empty), the Tribune tab files the WJW and WGN tab pages load (wjw_schools.html 2017-01-31 with two rows, wgn_schools.html 2019-03-01 empty) and the Gannett-era TEGNA Closings Alert List (KTHV 2017-01-06 with 159 rows; KPNX 2017, KENS 2017, KVUE 2018 and KXTV 2018 empty). WUTR's 2017 page and WRIC's 2016 page framed list files (s3.amazonaws.com/nxsglobal/cnyhomepage/closings/closings.html, wx.wric.com/weather/WRIC_closings_delays.html) that have not been captured or asked for.

From 2026-09-28 (round 4), 'no_endpoint_scripps_tegna' records the listings and captures asked for the 18 Scripps and TEGNA sites registered with no endpoint and KMSB's older hosts (commits 1eadbc8, 4214b42, 7b1fc13 and f13b2c8); the four Scripps stations whose sites are still Gray's (KJCT, KKCO, KKTV, KMVT) are read through their Gray entries, whose captures part 1 downloaded. Run 36360179859 read KSTU's closings page typed by hand on the Utah snow day of 2023-02-22 (18 lines; KSTU is now registered), and the Montana stations' pages, WWL's, KIII's and KRIS's closings modules empty. The same round read the closings pages typed by hand that earlier rounds could not (WHNT 2021-02-15 with 38 lines and 2025-01-08 with 5, WDHN 2025-02-01 with 40, WRBL 2024-09-26 with 43, WNTZ's 2017 article with a typed table of 62): WHNT, WDHN and WRBL are now registered with their pages' REST objects. f13b2c8 also asks for further winter captures of those typed pages and of the closings pages of WGNO, KLAS, KTSM and KVEO. The plain listings (run 36369419399) showed closings addresses the first-hand check had not tried: KPAX's /school-closings-delays and KGUN's and KTNV's /weather/closings-and-delays, where the Scripps closings module answers live (empty on 2026-09-28; those three are now registered), and older /weather/school-closings-delays pages of KPAX, KXLF, KRIS, KGUN and KNXV; ec162d3 asks for their winter captures. The site-wide listings (every address naming closings on each host) of runs 36360179859 and 36364542360 had not come back when this was written: the CDX server answered very slowly that night.

On 2026-09-28 (round 5) the stations whose closings pages are typed by hand moved to their own platform files, so that only they are read as typed pages: WHNT, WDHN, WRBL and WNTZ to nexstar-typed.yaml, KSTU and the Montana stations (KTVQ, KXLF, KRTV, KTVH, KXLH) to scripps-typed.yaml. Their entries above are keyed by their new source ids (nexstar-typed-whnt, scripps-typed-kstu and so on); what was asked for them, and when, is unchanged.

On 2026-09-28 (round 6) KIAH and WIVB moved to nexstar-typed.yaml (source ids nexstar-typed-kiah and nexstar-typed-wivb): both type closings into their closings page beside the closings article. The captures already downloaded were read again: KIAH's cw39.com/weather/closings/ of 2025-01-25T18:39:00Z and 2026-01-11T12:44:31Z (asked for as 20250121120000 and 20260126140000, runs 36300019096 and 36318474516) hold eight districts typed below the empty article and now read with 8 rows (nexstar-page-typed-beside; they were read as empty before), and WHNT's whnt.com/weather-closings/ of 2018-12-11T02:38:20Z (run 36373148805), the Tribune-era template, now reads with 25 rows (nexstar-typed-entry-content; refused before). No new capture was needed for this; nothing else read by this part changed.
